core.headline: Detached cottage with riverbank garden, Yalding
core.summary: A detached cottage dating from c.1850 with a garden running to the River Beult, wood-burning stove, exposed beams, driveway parking and oil-fired central heating, in a village with a pub and primary school
core.listing:
Mill Cottage is a detached three-bedroom cottage dating from c.1850, set on Riverside Lane in Yalding with a garden that runs to the River Beult. The cottage has a wood-burning stove, exposed beams and driveway parking.

The ground floor has two reception rooms. One reception room contains a wood-burning stove and exposed beams. The ground floor also has a kitchen and a bathroom.

On the first floor are three bedrooms and a second bathroom.

The garden runs to the riverbank of the River Beult.

Yalding is a village with a pub and primary school.

Offers in Excess of £575,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band E (Maidstone Borough Council). EPC rating E. Construction: standard. Electricity: mains. Water: mains (metered). Sewerage: septic tank. Heating: oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: driveway. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known. Flooding: the ground floor flooded from the River Beult in December 2013 and February 2020; flood doors and non-return valves fitted 2021; insured through a Flood Re-backed policy.
keyFeatures: Garden running to the River Beult
Village location with pub and primary school
Flood doors and non-return valves fitted 2021 (flooded 2013 and 2020)
